name: Western Ghats Moist Deciduous Forest
description: Global biodiversity hotspot containing diverse tropical evergreen and moist deciduous forest ecosystems.
notes: Monitor selective logging and canopy density shifts.

name: Jim Corbett National Park & Tiger Reserve
description: Sub-Himalayan belt dense Sal, Haldu, and Peepal tree forest cover.

name: Kaziranga National Park
description: Floodplain tall elephant grass and tropical moist broadleaf forest along the Brahmaputra River.
notes: Annual monsoon flooding and seasonal vegetation changes.

name: Sundarbans Mangrove Biosphere
description: World's largest contiguous tidal halophytic mangrove ecosystem.
notes: Tidal variation, salinity stress, and coastal mangrove canopy integrity.

name: Amazon Basin — Rondônia Deforestation Arc
description: Tropical rainforest active deforestation frontier with historical fishbone road clearings.
notes: High priority: cattle ranching and pasture expansion clear-cuts.

name: Black Forest (Schwarzwald)
description: Temperate coniferous and broadleaf mountain forest in Southwestern Germany.
notes: Bark beetle infestation tracking and summer drought canopy stress.
